abstract: YEASTRACT+ (http://yeastract-plus.org/) is a tool for the analysis, prediction, and modelling of transcription regulatory data at gene and genomic levels in yeasts. It incorporates three integrated databases: YEASTRACT, PathoYeastract, and NCYeastract, focused on Saccharomyces cerevisiae, pathogenic yeasts, and non-conventional yeasts of biotechnological relevance, respectively. In this release, YEASTRACT+ offers upgraded information on transcription regulation for 13 yeast species, extending the database to two additional yeasts of the basidiomycota phylum, the pathogenic yeast Cryptococcus neoformans, and the biotechnologically relevant Rhodotorula toruloides. A dramatic upgrade in the quality of the data provided occurred, as regulatory associations between transcription factors (TFs) and target genes are now associated with quantitative assessment. Quantitative impact of TFs on gene expression levels enabled the construction and release of two additional analytical tools: quantitative rank by TF, for the prediction of the most relevant TFs underlying a given transcriptomics dataset; and metabolic engineering based on integrating the quantitative impact of TF expression into genome-scale metabolic models. Altogether, this release of YEASTRACT+ provides unparalleled access to massive, curated, quantitative data associated with gene expression control in 13 yeast species, and a set of tools to enable its full exploitation towards fundamental, biotechnological, and health-related applications.
